Class ViewDiscussions

java.lang.Object
application.ViewDiscussions
public class ViewDiscussions extends Object

ViewDiscussions

This class models a modern discussion board. Allows Logged in Users with Student Roles to Post Questions and Answers. This Board also allows Users with Reviewer roles to Review Questions and Answers

  • Method Details

    • showReplies

      public void showReplies(Answer parentAnswer, AnswersList answersList, javafx.stage.Stage primaryStage, User user, Boolean loadOnlyTrustedReviewers, ArrayList<ReviewerRating> global, String accessRole)
      This little guy will will recursively display each Sub answer/review (and any subsequent recursive subreplies of each of those). To comply with Employer requests, this function will make sure all reviews are listed before any answers are listed, but more importantly will list all reviews (recursively) in ranked order based on a global ranking points sytstem. It will then list any answers. This is not the function for direct answers or reviews to the original question, but merely a function to generate the reviews and answers to already posted reviews and answers.
      Parameters:
      parentAnswer - This used to get the ID of the Answer inwhich we use to find all sub reviews and answer to generate on the board.
      answersList - This is passed to avoid another generation of the list of answers and reviews from the database.
      primaryStage - This is passed to allow the user to open new stages from particular buttons generated on a review or answer.
      user - Passed to keep track of current User info (in particular the username)
      loadOnlyTrustedReviewers - This is passed as a way to tell whether the user wants to list only the reviews from his Trusted reviewers.
      global - This is the global rating list that holds the ranking list of the reviewers on a global scale, it is passed to avoid another query.

    • show

      public void show(javafx.stage.Stage primaryStage, User user, Question loadThisQuestion, boolean loadOnlyTrustedReviewers, String accessRole)
      This is the main Beast of the discussion board.
        Simply put this function:
      • Generates buttons for each Quetion in the Database
      • And on click of these question buttons, will build the discussion board itself
      • The board will generate boxes first for each review (in a globally ranked order and can show only reviews from trusted reviewers)
      • The board will then generate boxes for all answers
      • Allows the student to reply, edit, delete, and set reviews or questions as the preffered solution
      Parameters:
      primaryStage - To allow for transitions to other stages and refreshes
      user - To keep track of user information
      loadThisQuestion - To reload/refresh a particular question back into the board upon creation/deletion/addition of answers/reviews
      loadOnlyTrustedReviewers - To see if the user wants to load only reviews from trusted reviewers, or just all reviewers
